metadata.description: Information Logistics plugin marketplace. Thirteen engineering and design skills: process discipline, the wargame meta loop, JTBD validation, sizing, structural audit, agent orchestration, type scales, brand audits, and the HTML composition family (generator-critic loop, component-composer, infolog-io + infolog-terminal themes, html-sketch).

plugins.name: claude-pip
plugins.description: Performance Improvement Plan for Claude. Three triggers: CLAUDE PIP adds a master rule; LOCAL PIP scopes a rule to the current directory; OFF THE PIP removes a rule cleanly. Every rule wrapped in HTML-comment markers so it can be removed mechanically.

plugins.name: jtbd-prd
plugins.description: Validate customer need before you build. Produces a Job Article that functions as PRD framing, grounded in Jobs-to-be-Done evidence.

plugins.name: estimatrix
plugins.description: Two-axis sizing rubric for effort AND complexity. Effort as T-shirt (XS / S / M / L / XL / XXL); complexity as low / medium / high. Runs active conversational intake (jtbd-style) to fill missing scope and success criteria before sizing. Applies Karpathy's four code rules: state assumptions, ask if ambiguous, prefer simpler scope, require a success criterion.

plugins.name: learn2kern
plugins.description: Typography skill. Generates modular type scales (eight named ratios from Minor Second to Golden Ratio) with BODY and HEADINGS as separate token families, line-height bands, letter-spacing per band. Emits CSS custom properties and Tailwind theme.fontSize. Color slots reference atomic-brand tokens. Runs conversational intake when inputs are missing.

plugins.name: semantic-organization
plugins.description: Meta-skill that governs how every skill is structured. Codifies the Anthropic Agent Skills directory convention (skills/<name>/SKILL.md flat — no plugin wrapper), folder roles, naming rules, migration triggers. Scaffolds, audits, recommends migrations.

plugins.name: atomic-brand
plugins.description: Audits web projects against atomic design discipline and brand-token coherence. Detects token violations, atomic hierarchy drift, naming by appearance, scattered components, brand drift, and scale violations. Emits a scored audit plus a refactor plan or build-out plan. Failover chain: explicit tokens → image parse → URL scrape. Web medium first; native and other mediums spin out as sibling skills.

plugins.name: github-issues-kanban
plugins.description: Agent orchestration substrate built on GitHub Issues + Projects V2. Defines three concurrency primitives (access lock with TTL, dependency chain DAG, comment-based event bus) so multiple agents can claim and work tasks in parallel without conflict. Includes audit, triage, generate, list, and dispatch modes. Confirm-first by default; YOLO bypass available. Four archetype templates: personal-todo, writing-pipeline, oss-triage, sprint-planning. Protocol is agent-agnostic.

plugins.name: generator-critic
plugins.description: Abstract generator-critic loop pattern. Consumed by composer-style skills (HTML, code, schemas, prose) that need iterative refinement against declared criteria. Defines the loop, abstract drafter + validator contracts, HUD overlay, and audit-summary format.

plugins.name: component-composer
plugins.description: Production-grade single-file HTML data graphics via generator-critic loop (depends on the generator-critic skill). Use when consistency across artifacts, themes, viewports, and time matters. Do NOT use for casual or throwaway HTML — see html-sketch or just ask Claude.

plugins.name: infolog-io
plugins.description: Tufte-quiet design theme for component-composer. Light + dark + system modes. DM Sans body, JetBrains Mono numerics, Georgia editorial serif optional. Perfect-5th type scale, 4/8/12 column grid, semantic callouts.

plugins.name: infolog-terminal
plugins.description: Terminal-aesthetic theme for component-composer. Dark-only (green-on-black). JetBrains Mono throughout, monospace caps headings, ASCII bars inline, sharp borders, tabular numerics.

plugins.name: html-sketch
plugins.description: Casual single-file HTML artifacts in Thariq Shihipar's 'Unreasonable Effectiveness of HTML' style. Throwaway editors, side-by-side variant comparisons, interactive tuning with sliders/knobs, single-page reports. No validator loop, no themes, no industrial QA. Includes copy-as-prompt footer pattern for round-tripping back into Claude.

plugins.name: wargame
plugins.description: Meta loop + eval system for product engineering. Wargame missions on paper before execution: BRIEF, WARGAME, GRADE, RED-TEAM, EXECUTE, VERIFY, RETRO. Plans graded pass/fail against a 9-point rubric plus repo extensions, red-teamed until an honest break attempt fails, then handed to a cheaper executor. Every artifact the executor is graded against is read-only to it; every verification command is validated against known-good and known-bad input before the route trusts it. Ledger tracks predicted-vs-actual; retros patch the system itself.

plugins.name: wireframe2eval
plugins.description: Turn a redesign into a content contract. Extracts headings, CTAs, and copy from the live source into a versioned inventory, then generates an eval that fails when the redesign silently drops any of it.
